purpose: Add directly curated high-value mechanism, crypto-derivatives, execution, and anti-overfit evidence. Evidence may generate or falsify one-axis hypotheses but may not contribute a numeric strategy threshold or promotion decision.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.mechanism: Repeated strategy search can create apparently strong backtests that degrade out of sample; use search-aware validation rather than treating the best in-sample result as evidence.
sources.limitations: Does not supply trading alpha or a crypto-specific threshold; it is a validation-control source.

sources.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality
sources.mechanism: Performance inference must account for multiple trials and non-normal returns before a discovered edge is treated as statistically credible.
sources.limitations: DSR is not a replacement for fresh causal replay and does not authorize parameter optimization.

sources.title: Pseudo-Mathematics and Financial Charlatanism: The Effects of Backtest Overfitting on Out-of-Sample Performance
sources.mechanism: Trying many configurations materially increases the chance of selecting an overfit strategy; trial history must be preserved and duplicate retries must not reset the search count.
sources.limitations: General validation evidence, not a crypto signal source.

sources.title: Trend Following: Equity and Bond Crisis Alpha
sources.mechanism: Time-series momentum behavior varies across lags and restrictions; trend evidence supports testing speed/side ownership as distinct axes rather than assuming one universal trend horizon.
sources.limitations: Traditional futures evidence is not direct proof for crypto perpetuals and cannot justify copying horizons or leverage.

sources.title: Trend Following Strategies: A Practical Guide
sources.mechanism: Trend implementation and time-scale alignment matter; multi-scale hypotheses should be evaluated without best-horizon cherry-picking.
sources.limitations: Cross-asset review and simulation evidence; local crypto costs and fresh validation remain mandatory.

sources.title: Bitcoin intraday time series momentum
sources.mechanism: Bitcoin intraday momentum strength varies with high-volume/high-volatility trading sessions, supporting causal tests of session and activity-state ownership.
sources.limitations: Spot Bitcoin intraday evidence is not direct perpetual-futures alpha and paper timing definitions must not be copied as strategy thresholds.

sources.title: MAX momentum in cryptocurrency markets
sources.mechanism: Crypto momentum effects can vary with market conditions and sentiment, supporting regime-dependent momentum ownership rather than unconditional indicator stacking.
sources.limitations: Cross-sectional/holding-period evidence differs from BTC/ETH perpetual signal execution and cannot supply numeric thresholds.

sources.title: Momentum Effects in the Cryptocurrency Market After One-Day Abnormal Returns
sources.mechanism: Large abnormal crypto returns can be followed by momentum behavior; this is evidence for testing discrete momentum-state ownership and falsification by regime.
sources.limitations: Daily abnormal-return design is not a direct intraday perpetual-futures entry rule.

sources.title: High-frequency dynamics of Bitcoin futures: An examination of market microstructure
sources.mechanism: High-frequency Bitcoin/Ethereum perpetual-futures volatility is linked to transaction activity and trade-size dynamics; microstructure claims should be tested with source-appropriate data rather than OHLCV proxies when L2/trade flow is required.
sources.limitations: Binance 2020-2024 evidence is venue-specific and does not validate a BingX execution threshold.

sources.source_family: Research in International Business and Finance/Elsevier
sources.title: Price discovery in bitcoin futures
sources.mechanism: Bitcoin futures can contribute materially to price discovery and show intraday volatility dependence with spot, supporting derivatives-aware session/price-discovery hypotheses.
sources.limitations: CME-style futures/spot price discovery does not establish BingX perpetual entry timing or profitability.

sources.title: Ethereum futures and the efficiency of cryptocurrency spot markets
sources.mechanism: Derivative-market development can alter persistence and efficiency characteristics, supporting explicit long/short and regime robustness checks instead of assuming stationary edge.
sources.limitations: Daily spot/futures efficiency evidence is not a direct intraday signal recipe.

sources.source_family: Journal of International Money and Finance/Elsevier
sources.title: Price discovery in bitcoin spot and futures markets
sources.mechanism: High-frequency lead-lag and transaction-size effects matter in fragmented Bitcoin price discovery; source granularity must match the causal claim.
sources.limitations: Does not justify using coarse OHLCV as a substitute for unavailable trade-flow or L2 data.

sources.title: Demystifying Time-Series Momentum Strategies: Volatility Estimators, Trading Rules and Pairwise Correlations
sources.mechanism: Trend implementation choices can change turnover and transaction-cost retention; cost compression should be evaluated as a separate axis rather than confused with signal alpha.
sources.limitations: Traditional futures evidence; no external parameter or cost estimate is adopted into ZEL.

sources.title: The Impact of Volatility Targeting
sources.mechanism: Volatility targeting can reduce tail severity even where Sharpe improvement is asset-dependent; scaled portfolio gains must be separated from unscaled signal edge.
sources.limitations: Not crypto-specific and explicitly shows asset-class dependence, so a positive result cannot be assumed for crypto.

sources.title: BingX adjusts BX perpetual funding settlement frequency to 1 hour
sources.mechanism: Funding settlement cadence can be one hour and may change again, so funding exposure must use instrument/time-specific source data.
sources.limitations: Instrument-specific notice; not a market-direction signal.

sources.title: BingX adjusts VOXELUSDT perpetual funding settlement frequency to 2 hours
sources.mechanism: Funding cadence is not universally 8h and can differ by instrument, reinforcing runtime source binding rather than hard-coded settlement assumptions.
sources.limitations: Instrument-specific notice; not a market-direction signal.
